explanation_full: Based on the SHAP analysis (Figure 3B), the feature with the highest mean absolute SHAP value is ORP_Low (0.0359). This indicates that ORP_Low is the most influential feature among the analyzed variables. Following ORP_Low, ORP_Mid (0.0314), Butyrate (0.0311), and VFA (0.0289) show decreasing levels of importance. The analysis confirms that ORP_Low is the most critical predictor, followed by ORP_Mid, Butyrate, and VFA in descending order of influence.
